mechanism: A relationship where manipulating one event directly forces another to occur — a directed edge in the causal graph. The definitional property is intervention-responsiveness: an external change to the cause alters the effect, which distinguishes causation from mere co-movement.
invariants: Intervention-responsive: an external change to the cause alters the effect.
Directed: intervening on the effect does not alter the cause along the same edge.
failure_modes: Asserted without intervention: where no intervention is possible, the definitional property is claimed rather than tested.
Confounded: a third variable drives both, so intervening on the named cause would not move the effect.
